data.title: Warm path: no unconditional readAll, refresh snapshot after write
data.description: B4. loadState always calls readAll (task.ts:312): a warm call reads 10103 files at 10k events; cold reads every event twice. Warm ~330 ms, read right after a write ~540 ms, against the 200 ms budget; fine at 1k. Writes do not refresh the snapshot. Re-measure after the change (CLAUDE.md). Evidence: docs/research/contract-stress-audit-2026-09.md §6
